Package com.signalwire.sdk.skills

Interface SkillBase

All Known Implementing Classes:
ApiNinjaTriviaSkill, ClaudeSkillsSkill, CustomSkillsSkill, DatasphereServerlessSkill, DatasphereSkill, DatetimeSkill, GoogleMapsSkill, InfoGathererSkill, JokeSkill, MathSkill, McpGatewaySkill, NativeVectorSearchSkill, PlayBackgroundFileSkill, SpiderSkill, SwmlTransferSkill, WeatherApiSkill, WebSearchSkill, WikipediaSearchSkill
public interface SkillBase
Interface for all skills. Skills are modular capabilities that can be added to agents to provide tools, prompts, hints, and global data.
